subject: Quick feedback on deck
text: Hi, when you have a minute, could you take a quick look at the slide deck? I hit a small technical issue while exporting the chart, and I am not sure whether the labels will stay visible on the meeting screen. There is nothing urgent, but I would value your eye on layout and spacing. A one-line reply would be perfect. If it looks fine, I will lock the final version tonight so the rest of the team can review it tomorrow morning.
